custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location only.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test at location B only, with its part number in capital letters, so it is a separate entry the test location does not stock.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425692-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425692-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows part B's number in small letters.

Step 4:

  • The change is saved and the window closes, and part A's row shows the small-letter number.

Step 5:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 6:

  • Two entries are listed: part B's (stocked at location B), unchanged in capital letters, and the small-letter one, which is renamed part A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”
  • Key Decisions: “A rename follows the same match rule as linking. A rename is refused only when another Part Library entry has exactly the typed number: the same characters, with the same upper and lower case.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • §1 Clarifications, Q2 S13-N1 rename refusal: “Exact (same characters and case), like create's link rule.”
  • Phase 6 unit tests, PartLibraryNumberCollisionCheckerTest: “"brake01" vs "BRAKE-01" allowed; "BRAKE-01" refused; own core excluded”
